But we can estimate from fuel range and consumption. FuelRange: 560 km remaining. Avg fuel consumption: 8.2 L/100km. So fuel left in liters = (fuelRange / 100) * avg consumption = 560/100*8.2 = 5.6*8.2 = 45.92 liters. Convert to gallons: 45.92 / 3.785 = ~12.13 gallons. So tank capacity 50 gallons, so remaining 12.13 gallons. So need to add 37.87 gallons. Let's round to 37.9 gallons. Then call fillFuelTank with 37.9.
